page_title: Achieve even more.Nuance is now Microsoft.

summary.name: Nuance
summary.one_liner: Nuance is a speech recognition and AI company whose website now states that Nuance is part of Microsoft, offering productivity and healthcare speech solutions.
summary.what_it_does: The page is the homepage for Nuance, which states that Nuance is now Microsoft. It promotes speech recognition solutions for productivity, aimed at helping people do their work more efficiently. It also lists AI-powered solutions for healthcare, targeting physicians and radiologists. A linked Microsoft for Healthcare section mentions safeguarding data, connected experiences, and getting more from data. The page is mostly marketing and does not give specific technical details, features, or pricing.
notable: Nuance is now part of Microsoft, per the page banner
AI-powered solutions for physicians and radiologists
caveats: Page is mostly marketing and gives no pricing or technical specifications
Branding has moved to Microsoft, so the Nuance name may redirect to Microsoft offerings
